}

  "ps_supplycost" REAL [not null]
  "ps_availqty" INTEGER
  "ps_comment" TEXT
}

Table "region" {
  "r_regionkey" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "r_name" TEXT
  "r_comment" TEXT
}

Table "supplier" {
  "s_suppkey" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "s_nationkey" INTEGER
  "s_comment" TEXT
  "s_name" TEXT
  "s_address" TEXT
  "s_phone" TEXT
  "s_acctbal" REAL
}
